This unit audits live gates, names the both-states rule, cites the restored DESIGN as tree context, and does not rebuild it (no ADV rebuild circle).
answer: Security controls fail open here in four measured ways: (1) a TEXT guard is silent on structured Bash USE and fires on mention (G-TEXT-PAYLOAD, L-STUB-TEXT); (2) completeness with require-flag default off skips a missing artifact (G-CI-REQUIRE-OFF); (3) a detector silent in both states measures nothing (G-SILENT); (4) absent input normalizes to PASS (G-ABSENT-PASS, L-EXISTENCE-SKIP, A1 unlisted_file). Both-states rule: every gate must FIRE on known-broken, be silent on known-good, fail-close on absent input, default require ON, and stay silent on mention-only documents. Audit n=13 fail_open=['G-TEXT-PAYLOAD', 'G-CI-REQUIRE-OFF', 'G-ABSENT-PASS', 'L-EXISTENCE-SKIP', 'L-A1-UNLISTED'] measuring_nothing=['G-SILENT']. A7 DESIGN.json absent (no choke-point coverage claim). Reviewer added FM-EXCEPT-PASS. SUCCESS:ARC-0047

question: Enumerate the ways a security control fails OPEN here: a guard matching payload TEXT instead of the tool VERB (the measured use-versus-mention class), a completeness check whose require-flag defaults to off in CI, a detector silent in both broken and fixed states, and a gate whose absent input normalizes to a passing value. Specify the both-states control EVERY security gate must ship with, and audit the existing gates against it.

added_failure_mode.description: The four catalog classes assume the gate function returns a decision. If evaluation raises (bad fixture, missing import, JSON decode of the policy file) and the caller treats that exception as allow/pass, the gate is silent on a broken input without matching TEXT, skipping a require-flag, always-returning-pass, or normalizing a missing *input* field. It is a fifth fail-open: missing *evaluator*, not missing input.
added_failure_mode.required_followup: except around a security gate must FAIL-CLOSE. Both-states for this class is: plant an eval error on a known-broken event and assert FIRE; restore a clean evaluator and assert the good event is silent.
added_failure_mode.title: Evaluator exception returns PASS

reviewer.method: Re-ran the both-states audit table. Agreement with which live gate is 'the' choke point is not required for PASS; scope is: both-states table, use-vs-mention, four named fail-open classes, one missed mode.

scenario.catching_architecture: A7 security-first both-states rule: every security gate ships a known-broken fixture that MUST fire and a known-good fixture that MUST be silent; text-matching gates add a mention-only document that MUST be silent; absent input MUST fail-close; CI require-flag MUST default ON. Catching evaluator is the tool VERB at a single choke point (ARC-0045 DESIGN not on this tree).
scenario.on_this_estate: Audited 13 gates. FAIL-OPEN=['G-TEXT-PAYLOAD', 'G-CI-REQUIRE-OFF', 'G-ABSENT-PASS', 'L-EXISTENCE-SKIP', 'L-A1-UNLISTED']. MEASURING-NOTHING=['G-SILENT']. Use-vs-mention FAIL=['G-TEXT-PAYLOAD', 'L-STUB-TEXT'] OK=['G-TOOL-VERB']. A7 DESIGN.json present as bootstrap-restored content, untouched by this unit.
procedure: 1. Instantiate the four catalog fail-open classes as executable gates with known-broken, known-good, and (for text-matching) mention-only events.
2. Inventory live gates on this tree: STUB_PAT, existence-skip, architecture-review schema, A1 loader unlisted/duplicate, measure artifact predicates.
3. Run each gate on both states and record FIRE/PASS; classify MEASURING-NOTHING when both are silent.
4. Feed each text-matching gate a document that MENTIONS the forbidden pattern; record whether it fires.
5. Do not create command-center/phase3/A7/DESIGN.json; record the restored-bootstrap presence with its mtime witness.
6. Independent reviewer adds one missed fail-open class instead of certifying 47 unread seeded lines.
scenario.title: Four fail-open classes plus live-gate both-states audit
